instruction: From the terminal, convert all .doc files in the current directory to .txt format at once.

command: cd /home/user/Desktop && tar -zcf txt.tar.gz *.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'no txt files'
output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "(soffice|libreoffice).+--convert-to\s+txt.+\*\.doc"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "failed to complete this task"; else echo "catch the desired command"; fi
